title: How to Cancel Peacock — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel your Peacock Premium subscription in 2 minutes. Stop the monthly charge and switch to free tier. All steps covered.
intro: Peacock has a free tier, so 'canceling' really means downgrading from Premium to Free. You'll still have access to some content with ads — just not the full library.

steps.title: Go to Peacock account settings
steps.text: Visit peacocktv.com, sign in, and click your profile icon → Account. Or go directly to peacocktv.com/account/plan.

steps.title: Click on your current plan
steps.text: Under "Plan & Payment", click on your current subscription (Peacock Premium or Premium Plus). You'll see your billing details.

steps.title: Select "Cancel Plan"
steps.text: Click "Cancel Plan" or "Downgrade". Peacock will show what content you'll lose and may offer a retention deal.
steps.tip: If you mainly watch NBC next-day content, the free tier still includes some of it — you may not need Premium.

steps.title: Confirm your cancellation
steps.text: Click through retention offers and confirm. You'll be downgraded to the free tier at the end of your billing period. A confirmation email will be sent.

warnings: If subscribed through Apple, Google, Roku, or Comcast/Xfinity, cancel through their respective platforms.
Comcast/Xfinity customers may have Peacock Premium included free with their internet plan — check before canceling.
The free tier has limited content and more ads. Premium exclusives and live sports won't be available.
Downloaded content becomes unavailable after Premium expires.

faqs.q: Is there a free version of Peacock?
faqs.a: Yes. Peacock Free gives you access to a limited library with ads. You don't need a paid subscription to use Peacock at all — just downgrade to the free tier.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Peacock?
faqs.a: Peacock does not typically offer refunds for partial billing periods. Contact NBC Universal support for billing errors.

faqs.q: Do Comcast customers get Peacock free?
faqs.a: Many Comcast/Xfinity internet and TV customers get Peacock Premium included at no extra charge. Check your Xfinity account benefits before paying separately.

faqs.q: What content is Peacock Premium only?
faqs.a: Premium exclusives include next-day NBC shows, Peacock originals, live sports (NFL, Premier League), and most movies. The free tier has older content and limited episodes.

refund.details: Peacock does not offer refunds for unused subscription time. You retain Premium access until your billing cycle ends, then revert to the free tier.

retentionTactics: Peacock may offer a discounted rate for a few months.
They'll remind you of upcoming live sports events or exclusive premieres.
